args.goal: Assess whether the existing Shopify catalogue QA download can be offered as a self-serve digital product through Lemon Squeezy. First read relevant lessons and prior platform decisions, and reuse any equivalent current evidence. Use official public sources to verify Canadian seller and payout eligibility, any upfront or recurring costs, per-sale fees, product and AI restrictions, and whether the platform offers buyer discovery or only checkout. Compare one existing catalogue QA artifact with the documented product rules and its reuse rights. If the route qualifies, save a listing-ready draft for the existing artifact, calculate net proceeds at one explicitly hypothetical price using documented fees, and state the exact account, review and payout prerequisites. If any decisive prerequisite is unavailable or ambiguous, save the scoped verdict and the evidence that would change it. Do not build inventory, register, accept terms, contact anyone, publish or spend. Read committed evidence before closing with a valid lease and a lesson.
